audit_items.proof_trace: The code computes subnet via ComputeSubnetForDataColumnSidecar (line 488) and immediately broadcasts to that subnet (line 490) without validating that the local node is subscribed to or has custody of that subnet. The broadcaster only checks peer availability, not local node subscription state.
audit_items.attack_scenario: A validator proposing a block broadcasts data column sidecars to all computed subnets (0-127) regardless of which subnets the local node is subscribed to. This violates the PeerDAS invariant requiring publishing only on subscribed (custody or sampling) subnets, causing network inefficiency and non-compliant gossip behavior.
